description: Thirty simulated inbound requests from markets, dealers, engineering and sales for one synthetic vehicle, with gold clusters, topics and scope flags written by the evaluation pod. Separate from Pod C's six-request demo set. Origins are fictional and every request is labelled simulated.
labelling_guide: A gold cluster groups requests that ask for the same customer-facing change, whatever their market, origin or wording. Each unique request is its own singleton cluster.
Clusters marked 'paraphrase' in a note share few words with the rest of their cluster, so token-overlap baselines are expected to miss them.

Scope flags follow the BMW boundaries: pricing (prices, discounts), homologation (type approval), engineering_spec (technical component specifications), supplier. Rough effort and package/variant decisions are in scope.
Topic is a server.analysis_engine.TOPICS key; out-of-scope requests have no gold topic (null) and are not scored on topic.

requests.title: More rear legroom for chauffeured owners
requests.body: Many owners in China are driven by a chauffeur and sit in the rear. They ask for more rear legroom for rear passengers.

requests.title: More rear legroom for rear passengers
requests.body: Customers at our showroom ask for more rear legroom for rear passengers before they buy.

requests.title: Rear legroom for chauffeured owners is a top request
requests.body: Sales consultants report that chauffeured owners want more rear legroom.

requests.title: Long-wheelbase option with extra rear seat space
requests.body: A few executive customers asked whether a long-wheelbase version with extra rear seat space will be offered.

requests.title: Back seat feels cramped for tall passengers
requests.body: Callers say tall passengers in the back seat feel cramped on longer journeys.

requests.title: Louder, sportier exhaust note
requests.body: US customers want a louder, sportier exhaust note when driving in Sport mode.

requests.title: Sportier exhaust note, louder in Sport mode
requests.body: Test drive customers ask for a sportier exhaust note that is louder in Sport mode.

requests.title: Louder exhaust sound in Sport mode
requests.body: Sales asks for a louder exhaust sound in Sport mode for customers coming from sports sedans.

requests.title: More emotional engine sound
requests.body: Enthusiast customers miss an emotional engine sound when accelerating.

requests.title: Ventilated rear seats
requests.body: Customers in hot climates ask for ventilated rear seats.

requests.title: Rear seat ventilation for hot climates
requests.body: Survey comments ask for rear seat ventilation for summer heat.

requests.title: Cooled rear seats for summer
requests.body: Rear passengers in southern China want cooled seats during the hot summer months.

requests.title: Physical climate buttons
requests.body: Customers ask for physical climate buttons instead of touch controls.

requests.title: Physical buttons for climate control
requests.body: Market research in Europe shows customers prefer physical buttons for climate control.

requests.title: Bring back physical climate control buttons
requests.body: Customers want physical climate control buttons back on the dashboard.

requests.title: Temperature knobs instead of touchscreen menus
requests.body: Callers want simple knobs to change the temperature without opening touchscreen menus.
requests.note: paraphrase; 'temperature' is also a comfort keyword

requests.title: Wireless CarPlay disconnects
requests.body: Owners report that wireless CarPlay disconnects during drives.

requests.title: Wireless CarPlay keeps disconnecting
requests.body: Service advisors hear that wireless CarPlay keeps disconnecting on longer drives.

requests.title: Fix wireless CarPlay disconnects
requests.body: Please fix the wireless CarPlay disconnects reported by our customers.

requests.title: Phone projection drops on long trips
requests.body: Owners say the phone projection connection drops after an hour on the highway.

requests.title: Larger cupholders
requests.body: Customers ask for larger cupholders.

requests.title: Larger cupholders for big bottles
requests.body: Owners want larger cupholders that fit big water bottles.

requests.title: Travel mugs do not fit the center console
requests.body: Commuters say their travel mugs do not fit in the center console holders.

requests.title: Customer relevance of a heat pump for winter range
requests.body: Engineering asks whether customers notice the loss of driving range in winter enough to make a heat pump a customer requirement.
requests.note: in scope: asks about customer relevance, not a component specification

requests.title: Keep the premium sound system in the base trim
requests.body: Owners say the premium sound system is worth the price and should stay in the base trim.
requests.note: hard negative: mentions price but asks for a package decision, which is in scope

requests.title: Lower the base price below the main competitor
requests.body: Sales wants the base price lowered below the main competitor's price.

requests.title: Discount the comfort package for fleet customers
requests.body: Fleet managers ask for a discount on the comfort package.

requests.title: Homologation of the new headlights for China
requests.body: Please confirm the homologation and type approval timeline for the new headlights in China.

requests.title: Specify the battery cell chemistry
requests.body: Engineering asks product management to specify the battery cell chemistry and the thermal management components.

requests.title: Change the seat foam supplier
requests.body: Purchasing suggests switching to a different seat foam supplier.
